brief.creative_description: Create a refined deep-teal and copper community recognition programme. Use abstract, people-free, text-free background artwork with calm content-safe areas.
brief.title: Community Excellence Awards

programme.title: Welcome by the master of ceremonies

direction.positive_prompt: The artwork should be abstract and people-free, with a calm and refined atmosphere, The background should feature subtle gradients and textures that evoke a sense of sophistication and community recognition, Keep the layout clean and modern, with plenty of white space around the content zones
direction.negative_prompt: Do not include any readable text, logos, watermarks, or portraits in the design. The background should be abstract and people-free.
direction.short_design_rationale: This design concept emphasizes elegance and sophistication through a deep teal and copper color palette. The abstract background creates a serene atmosphere for the event programme, ensuring that the focus remains on the content and the celebration of community recognition.

direction.positive_prompt: Abstract flowing lines of deep teal and burnished copper, resembling fluid metal and ocean currents, A luxurious, slightly blurred background with soft gradients and subtle textural details evocative of brushed velvet and polished stone, Atmospheric lighting with diffused highlights and shadows, Dreamy, ethereal, and elegant
direction.negative_prompt: sharp lines, hard edges, photographic, realistic, portraits, people, figures, text, words, logos, gradients, clutter, bright colours
direction.short_design_rationale: This direction aims for a sophisticated and refined aesthetic, reflecting the 'Contemporary community recognition' theme. The abstract background allows for a calming and unobtrusive presentation of the event information while visually communicating a sense of fluidity, connection and value.

direction.positive_prompt: Abstract background with subtle geometric patterns and gradients of deep teal and copper, Minimalist composition with clean, Soft, diffused lighting to create a calm and sophisticated atmosphere, Use of reflective surfaces and textured materials like brushed metal and smooth glass, Modern, sleek aesthetic with a sense of community and recognition
direction.negative_prompt: People, text, portraits, logos, cluttered, busy, ornate, traditional, vintage, bright colours, hard shadows, harsh lighting.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims to reflect a contemporary and refined aesthetic that aligns with the theme of community recognition. The use of deep teal and copper creates a sophisticated colour palette, while the abstract geometric patterns and minimalist composition ensure a calm and content-safe background. The soft lighting and reflective surfaces add depth and a modern touch, making the programme visually appealing and appropriate for all ages.
